gateway: isolated temporary home, approval=reads; one freshly seeded gateway each for the stub screenshots and the stub walkthrough
data: fictional: a made-up hiking club notebook, written through the app's own API (see data_notes)

agent_backend.stub: Kiro Crew's offline stub ACP backend (capture/stub_backend.py) for every other scene; no chat reply is shown from it
agent_backend.credit_reading: the browser answers the top bar's credit readout (/api/sessions/usage) with "no reading", so no account balance or email can be shown

note: The isolated gateway served the Notes app built into the Kiro Crew checkout (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/md_notebook, website/src/apps/md-notebook), because a gateway that still ships the built-in cannot install a second app under the same name. This repository is the externally packaged copy of that app: the same backend and the same page, ported. PORTING.md lists where the two differ; none of the differences is on screen in these pictures.
data_notes: capture/demo_vault.py made an empty git folder, /tmp/kc-notes-demo/trail-club-notes, with one empty commit by a made-up author; every note in it was then written through the app's own API (attach the folder, save each note, sync).
The hiking club, its members' first names and its trails are invented.
